Bill.BriefDescription: Designating Aplets and Cotlets as the state candy.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating Aplets and Cotlets as the statecandy; adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that: (1) The tree fruit industry is a vital part of the state's economy; (2) Products made from tree fruits have helped to keep the treefruit industry's competitive edge in the world marketplace; (3) Aplets and Cotlets are candies made in Washington using applesand apricots grown in Washington state; and (4) Aplets and Cotlets have been produced in Washington for overseventy years and identify Washington state to consumers worldwide.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Aplets and Cotlets are designated as the official candy of thestate of Washington.
